name: issue-poster
description: GitHub Action that publishes closed GitHub issues as Markdown posts
author: Rob Mensching

scripts.check: vp check src __tests__ .github docs action.yml package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.js README.md
scripts.format:write: vp fmt src __tests__ .github docs action.yml package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.js README.md --write
scripts.format:check: vp fmt src __tests__ .github docs action.yml package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.js README.md --check
scripts.all: npm run format:write && npm run check && vp test run && vp build
